name: Atmospheric 6.1.1
changelog:
* Added Cardinal Tetra variant
* Fixed Neon Tetra mistakingly being Cardinal Tetra
* Fixed on some occasions when placing Oranges
* Fixed rolling Dragon Fruits always facing the same direction
* Fixed Looting not affecting Cochineal drops
* Fixed Farmers Delight knives not mining Yucca Gateau faster

name: Atmospheric 6.1.0
changelog:
* Added Tetra, a new fish, to Rainforests (with data-driven variant registry)
* Added Carmine trim material
* Added Arid Glass
* Added sounds for Arid Sand, Arid Sandstone, Monkey Brush, Currant, and more
* Added support for Gallery
* Increased Arid Garden spawn rates
* Improved collision with Yucca plants
* Dolerite double slabs now have a special texture
* Fixed Water Hyacinth missing block offset
* Fixed mobs not avoiding Yucca, Aloe, and Barrel Cactus properly
* Fixed Yucca Leaf piles not being thorny
* Fixed Flowering Morado Leaf Pile rendering
* Fixed rolling Dragon Fruits not making a sound when they place
* Fixed a crash with rolling Dragon Fruit
* Fixed `sword_efficient` tag missing
* Fixed Trapped Chests missing proper names
* Fixed some issues with repaletters
